hypotheses.R0_factor_collection_is_exact: Maximum upstream-JVP and contraction error is at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.R1_full_batch_optimization_improves_vali: At least one learning rate improves validation fidelity by at least 0.02 over forward PCA.
hypotheses.R2_optimized_rank64_is_sufficient: The validation-selected rank-64 basis retains at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_optimized_rank64_beats_forward_pca: The selected basis exceeds forward PCA by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_optimized_subspace_transfers_ood: Each OOD fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.R5_training_improvement_is_not_pure_over: The learning rate with the best validation improves both train and validation fidelity over initialization.
hypotheses.R6_selected_basis_generalizes_to_fineweb: Held-out FineWeb fidelity is within 0.05 of selected validation fidelity.
